title: .orca-boat.json
description: Settings a repo commits for the Boat.dev sandbox Orca plugin. Local settings (sshUser, identityFile) belong in ~/.config/orca-boat/config.json and are refused here.

org.description: Boat organization name or id, as listed by `boat org list`. Leave out to use the account's active org.

environment.description: Boat environment for new sandboxes, as listed by `boat env list`. Leave out for the account's default environment.

snapshot.description: Named snapshot or bsh_ share code to start sandboxes from. Leave out for boat's stock image. Only name snapshots you trust: the repo's code runs on them.

setupScript.description: Path of a script inside the repo. It runs with `bash -l` in the project folder after the checkout, and a failure fails workspace creation.

ghWrapper.description: Install the gh wrapper that keeps Orca's GitHub actions working after boat's GitHub token expires.
